strategies.name: v1 (what we ran live)
strategies.desc: Normal curve around the forecast, fixed sigma 2.0/2.5F, no bias, 8c edge

strategies.name: v2 calibrated
strategies.desc: Same, but bias and sigma learned from past forecast misses

strategies.name: v2 + 50% market blend
strategies.desc: Average our chance with the market price; 4c edge

strategies.name: v2 + disagreement cap
strategies.desc: v2, but skip when model and market disagree by more than 25 points

strategies.name: Forecast bracket YES
strategies.desc: Buy YES on the bracket the calibrated forecast points at, if it costs 70c or less with 5c+ edge

strategies.name: Market favorite YES (no model)
strategies.desc: Buy YES on the market's top bracket when it costs 35-75c

verdict.text: No strategy made money in both halves with 30+ trades. Least bad: Market favorite YES (no model) (+8 on 2208 trades).
